hypothesis: The real-time Sahm Rule provides a transparent recession-state trigger based on labor-market deterioration rather than market prices. When the conservatively lagged prior-month SAHMREALTIME value is at least 0.50 percentage points, recession risk is confirmed and gold should be preferred; below the official 0.50 threshold, secular growth exposure remains in Nasdaq. Updating only once monthly after the 15th and only when ownership changes keeps turnover extremely low.

selection_metric: Use the official Sahm 0.50pp threshold exactly. Conservative prior-month-only availability and day-15 review are frozen for causality, not selected from returns. No threshold/lag search.
